title: Crochet Headband
description: A stylish twisted headband in simple single crochet. Soft, stretchy, and made in under 30 minutes.
expectationText: A satisfying instant-gratification project. You crochet a simple rectangle, twist it in the middle, and seam it into a comfortable headband.

steps.title: Start the band
steps.instruction: Chain 12 for a standard width headband. Adjust for wider or narrower.

steps.title: Row 1
steps.instruction: Single crochet into the second chain from hook and each chain across. Chain 1 and turn.

steps.title: Rows 2 to 48
steps.instruction: Single crochet across. Chain 1 and turn after each row.

steps.title: Shape the twist
steps.instruction: Place the band flat. Bring the two short ends together, twisting one end 180 degrees so the right sides face each other.

steps.title: Seam the ends
steps.instruction: Single crochet or slip stitch the two ends together. Weave in the ends. Turn it right-side out and enjoy the twisted front detail.
